titulo: How Long Does It Take to Learn a Language? A Polyglot's 8 Steps
caption: YouTube only (a regular 16:9 video). Instagram goes as its own piece (-ig) with its own caption.
descripcion:
How long does it take to learn a language? Sofia Balderson speaks seven languages, to varying degrees, and puts it at hundreds of hours, for most people a project of years. She says step 5 of her eight is where many people quit. Her post: https://notingthemargin.substack.com/p/how-i-learn-languages

Her eight steps are drawn in pencil on one long notebook page, with her stories, from Dostoevsky to dinner with Spanish-speaking in-laws. Her own English took books, films and podcasts, three hours or more a day, for two to three years. It ends at the level she says is enough to live, work at some jobs, and have relationships.

alt: A pencil drawing on one long paper page, travelled with fast sideways whip-pans. Seven speech bubbles, six tally marks and eight numbered boxes are drawn and rubbed out, leaving pink eraser ghosts. A mountain draws itself station by station; at each one a hand letters her step and small drawings: a Dostoevsky book under a menu, a dinner table, a dog walk, a sun. At step 5 the page holds still, then fills with tally marks, an hours counter and a book, a film and a microphone. Six struck-out headings, the empty summit held in silence, B1 to B2 at a dinner table, and the view pulling back over every residue. End card: What would you learn a language for? and the credit.
